# Paperboy — Your Own Filtered Firehose

Build a daily or weekly rollup from Hacker News, RSS, research, and public sources. Paperboy filters the firehose around what matters to you and delivers the cut automatically.

Canonical: https://newpaperboy.com/
Markdown: https://newpaperboy.com/index.md
